scale: 0-10 character-in-scene cohesion (delta-anchored; absolute number is NOT a quality verdict)
incumbent_note: the prior BEST full-stack cohesion frame on record (cohesion-probe-panel-1, 2026-07-09: median 3.2 on the OLD camp scene backdrop). Also used, unchanged, as the disclosed house-style anchor for this panel (same file -- scorers correctly read it as 'the reference itself').
control_note: REGISTERED clean control (real shipped PoE2:Deadfire ruins/brazier plate) from qa/visual_controls_identity.json, disguised as a blind slot.
prior_panel_ref: qa/evidence/plate-sprint/adopt-crypt/crypt_armb_iter3_cohesion_panel.json (2026-07-10, PRE-FIX): candidate median 6.0 vs control 9.0 (delta -3.0); 3/5 scorers flagged the two baseline-cast actors as standing on the sarcophagus -- the exact bug PROBE-PLACEMENT (#1386) fixes.

baseline_comparison.read: The PROBE-PLACEMENT fix (#1386: widened SARCOPHAGUS_CELLS to its true cols 3-9 x rows 3-7 footprint, relocated hero/goblin off it to (11,3)/(1,8)) both raised the candidate median (6.0 -> 7.0, +1.0) AND -- more importantly than the number -- eliminated the qualitative placement defect: where the pre-fix panel had 3/5 scorers flag actors standing on the sarcophagus, this panel has 5/5 scorers EXPLICITLY confirm no furniture-standing tell in the candidate ('goblin correctly grounded on the floor tile beside the sarcophagus's front-left corner, not on the tomb lid'). The candidate's delta-to-control (-1.0) now sits WITHIN the panel's own +/-1.2 noise band, meeting the bar this round (control medians are noisy panel-to-panel: 8.0 here vs 9.0 pre-fix, a normal ~1pt swing for a 5-scorer panel).

residual_defects: 2/5 scorers noted the actor sprites (hero + goblin) read flatter/more cutout-pasted than the richly painted stonework, a pre-existing PainterlyActor material gap (RungA') unrelated to placement

1/5 scorer (the harshest overall, who also scored the control/incumbent lowest at 4) rated the candidate 'lesser' house-style -- consistent with a globally stricter scale rather than a placement-specific issue
relight_note: Independent relight A/B (qa/evidence/1481/, PR #1488) already showed WOSRelight LOSES on this same styled plate. RungR/WOSRelight was NOT enabled for this capture.
iteration_note: iteration 1 (hero(11,3)/goblin(2,7)) still read as touching the tomb's front-left corner per a first blind panel pass (candidate median 6.0, house-style 'lesser' 4/5, all citing the goblin on the sarcophagus) -- widened SARCOPHAGUS_CELLS one more column (4-9 -> 3-9) and moved goblin to (1,8); iteration 2 is the panel recorded here.
verdict: Candidate median 7.0 vs registered PoE2 control median 8.0 (delta -1.0, within the +/-1.2 control band -- MEETS the bar) vs incumbent/house-best 8.0 this panel (same-file tell). All 5/5 scorers independently confirmed the placement fix holds: no actor stands on the sarcophagus. Versus the PRE-FIX panel (candidate 6.0 vs control 9.0, delta -3.0, 3/5 scorers flagging the placement bug), this is both a +1.0-point gain and -- the part that matters -- a clean fix of the felt bug.
